answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in beacon and orchard lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the lantern graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 724 impostors cost 829 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
